identifier.title: Used as filename or fragment reference
identifier.description: Common name; lowercased; used for lookups.

nonprofit.title: Type of nonprofit
nonprofit.description: Categorizing nonprofits: c3; c6; lf (Linux Foundation project); or non-US nonprofits.

sponsorurl.title: Sponsor URL
sponsorurl.description: URL to read list of current entity sponsors.

sourcetype.title: Source Type
sourcetype.description: How to read sponsorurl: css (scrape html with per-level selector/attr), landscape (CNCF-style landscape.yml), landscapejson (landscape2 site data/full.json), json (any JSON API, see json), yaml (a YAML data file, read like json), or static (levels.*.sponsors lists). If absent: static when staticmap is set, landscape when landscape is set, else css.

landscape.title: Landscape Category
landscape.description: For landscape or landscapejson sources: name of the landscape category listing members (or, in sources entries, a list of names it has had); its subcategories are matched to levels by match or name.

render.title: Render With Browser
render.description: For css sources whose sponsor list is built by JavaScript: 'chrome' renders sponsorurl in local headless Chrome/Chromium before scraping. Never used to get past bot-detection challenges.

json.title: JSON Field Paths
json.description: For json (and to override landscapejson) sources: dotted paths into the JSON. Arrays along a path are flattened.

items.description: Path to the array of sponsor objects; empty for a top-level array.

url.description: Field with the sponsor website; normalized to a domain.

name.description: Fallback field used when url is empty.

level.description: Field whose value(s) are matched to levels by match or name.

filter.description: Map of path to a value or list of values that items must have.

itemsByKey.description: True when items is a map of key to a list of items; each item's key is readable as _key.

defaultLevel.description: Level for items whose level field is missing.

sources.title: Historical Sources
sources.description: Where sponsor_archive.rb finds past versions of the sponsor list. Each entry has a kind and location, optional from/until dates (YYYYMMDD), and any model keys to use for that period (sourcetype, landscape, json, levels with match/selector/attr; a level set to null is removed; replaceLevels: true uses only the listed levels, e.g. a 'listed' level for lists without tiers).

path.description: git: file path in the repository (renames are followed).

branch.description: git: branch (default: the repository's default branch).

url.description: yearly-page: URL containing {year}; each page covers that calendar year. wayback: a single page URL.

urls.description: wayback: page URLs (every address the page has had); captures are fetched raw so links are the original sponsor links.

levelurl.title: Level URL
levelurl.description: URL to review for entity definition of sponsorship levels.

staticmap.title: Static Map Date
staticmap.description: If present, is ISO8601 date that the static levels.(first).sponsors[] array of sponsor hostnames was captured; we do not parse live.

sponsormap.title: Sponsor Static Mapping
sponsormap.description: If present, read a mapping file of URL fragments to sponsor hostnames (to simplify parsing of complex hrefs).

effectiveDate.title: Effective Date
effectiveDate.description: Date (YYYYMMDD) the current levels took effect; required when pastModels is present.

pastModels.title: Past Sponsorship Models
pastModels.description: Earlier models, each listing only what differed from the current model from its effectiveDate until the next model: top-level fields like levelurl, and per-level fields like name or amount. A level set to null did not exist then.

normalize.title: Normalize URL Flag
normalize.description: If true, normalize href URLs to one registrable domain per sponsor (subdomains merged; see _data/host_aliases.json). Landscape sources always normalize; json sources normalize unless set false.

first.description: Top or highest sponsorship level benefits.

firstinkind.description: Top or highest sponsorship level benefits for services / in-kind donors.

secondinkind.description: Second sponsorship level benefits for services / in-kind donors.

thirdinkind.description: Third sponsorship level benefits for services / in-kind donors.

fourthinkind.description: Fourth sponsorship level benefits for services / in-kind donors.

grants.description: Government, institutional or other funding grants.

community.description: Community group or other similar sponsorship level benefits.
